core: Cytokine control of NK and NKT cells
qualifier: IL-15, IL-21 and type I/III interferons
name: NK and NKT cell regulation by IL-15, IL-21 and interferons
rationale: Members are IL-15/IL-21 signaling, type I and III interferon responses and regulation of NK/NKT proliferation, differentiation and activation, distinguishing the theme from confusables built on IL-10, IL-12/23/27 and IL-20 family signaling.

name: RAS-RAF-MAPK cascade and oncogenic RAS/RAF variants
rationale: All members concern RAS activation and its control by GEFs/GAPs, RAF and MAP2K/MAPK activation, and disease mutants of RAS, BRAF, RAF1 and NF1, which the confusables (centred on ERK inactivation and MAPK mutants) lack.

core: tRNA maturation and mitochondrial RNA processing
qualifier: tRNA trafficking and mitochondrial RNA turnover
name: tRNA maturation, trafficking and mitochondrial RNA turnover
rationale: Members cover tRNA end processing, intron splicing, modification, transport and tRF biogenesis plus mitochondrial RNA processing, import and decay, without the aminoacylation or mitochondrial transcription/translation machinery of the confusables.

name: Mucin-type O-GalNAc glycosylation and its congenital defects
rationale: All members concern initiation and termination of O-GalNAc (mucin-type) glycan synthesis and GALNT/C1GALT1C1 deficiency diseases, unlike confusables on N-glycans, blood-group antigens and fucose metabolism.

name: FGFR-PI3K cascades and betaKlotho-dependent FGFR4 signaling
rationale: Members are the PI3K cascades of FGFR1-4 plus FGFR4 SHC/FRS signaling and betaKlotho ligand binding, separating it from confusables built on PLC-gamma cascades and FGFR1/2 FRS/SHC signaling.

core: Protein targeting to the plasma membrane
name: RHOQ-driven GLUT4 translocation to plasma membrane
rationale: Members are the RHOQ (TC10) GTPase cycle, GLUT4 translocation and protein targeting to membrane, i.e. the vesicle-delivery arm rather than the glucose-uptake, insulin-secretion or endosomal confusables.

name: Negative regulation of cell-matrix adhesion and Rho/Rac signaling
rationale: All members restrain integrin signaling, focal adhesions, lamellipodia and Rho/Rac signaling, unlike confusables centred on epithelial/endothelial migration, angiogenesis or positive protrusion control.

core: tRNA and rRNA modification and maturation
qualifier: aminoacylation and cytosolic rRNA modification for translational fidelity
name: tRNA and rRNA modification, maturation and aminoacylation
rationale: Members are dominated by tRNA processing, modification and charging plus cytosolic rRNA and mRNA modifications serving translational fidelity, lacking the mitochondrial gene-expression and protein-hydroxylation members of confusables.

qualifier: commissural midline crossing via SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, netrin-DCC and L1
name: Commissural axon guidance by SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, netrin and L1
rationale: Members cover SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, netrin-DCC and L1 signaling with midline choice and fasciculation, whereas confusables emphasise semaphorin/netrin repulsion or neuron-type-specific guidance.

core: Regulation of protein stability and proteasomal turnover
name: Protein stabilization versus proteasomal degradation, with TRiC/CCT folding
rationale: Members regulate protein stabilization, destabilization and K48/proteasomal degradation alongside TRiC/CCT-assisted folding, distinct from pure chaperonin folding, DUB, or misfolded-protein quality-control confusables.

name: Monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation and activation
rationale: All members are positive and negative regulation of monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation, activation and aggregation, while confusables add inflammatory cytokine production or CCR2/CX3CR1 expression modules.

core: Negative regulation of innate inflammatory signaling
qualifier: TLR, IL-1 and TNF to NF-kB
name: Suppression of TLR/IL-1/TNF–NF-κB signaling and inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members restrain TLR2/4, LPS, IL-1 and TNF signaling, canonical and non-canonical NF-kB, and proinflammatory cytokine output, unlike confusables mixing positive regulation, inflammasomes or T-cell responses.

qualifier: mucopolysaccharidoses I, II, VI and IX
name: Chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation and mucopolysaccharidoses I, II, VI, IX
rationale: Members are CS/DS catabolism and the MPS types I, II, VI and IX, whereas confusables centre on heparan or keratan sulfate degradation and Sanfilippo, Morquio or Sly syndromes.

qualifier: peptide and nutrient GPCRs, gut motility
name: Appetite and gut motility control by peptide/nutrient GPCRs
rationale: Members span ghrelin, leptin, amylin, CGRP/calcitonin, glucagon, somatostatin, relaxin and fatty-acid receptors with cAMP signaling, appetite, gastric secretion and GI motility, unlike confusables on GH/prolactin JAK-STAT and glucocorticoid axes.

name: RNA polymerase II pausing, elongation and termination control
rationale: Members regulate Pol II promoter clearance, pausing, elongation and termination, distinguishing it from confusables focused on HIV transcription, initiation/capping or nuclear organisation.

qualifier: early endosome sorting and receptor recycling
name: Endocytosis, early endosome sorting and receptor recycling
rationale: All members concern plasma-membrane-to-endosome transport, early-to-late and recycling endosome routing and receptor recycling, lacking the Golgi, secretory and Rab/ARF members of confusables.

qualifier: leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and vascular wound healing
name: Endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular injury remodeling
rationale: Members are endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion/extravasation, vascular wound healing and vessel remodeling, versus confusables on smooth-muscle behaviour, monocytes or VEGF/FGF-driven angiogenesis.

name: mRNA 3'-end processing and nuclear export, including histone mRNAs
rationale: Members combine cleavage/polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing, Pol II termination and mRNA export, distinguishing it from confusables limited to export or to cytoplasmic mRNA decay.

name: B cell development, differentiation and proliferation
rationale: Members are B cell differentiation, proliferation and B-cell-enriched modules, without the BCR signaling, germinal center/Tfh or homeostasis members of the confusables.

name: COPI-mediated retrograde Golgi-to-ER and intra-Golgi transport
rationale: Members are COPI budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde, intra-Golgi and endosome-to-Golgi transport and Golgi retention, unlike confusables on COPII ER export or Golgi structural organization.

core: Cyclic nucleotide control of blood pressure and natriuresis
name: Natriuretic peptide-cGMP control of natriuresis, heart rate and pressure
rationale: Members are cGMP synthesis and receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling, neuropeptide catabolism, sodium excretion, urine volume and heart rate, distinguishing the natriuretic arm from renin-angiotensin and vasoconstriction confusables.

name: XBP1 and ATF4 ER stress responses in beta-cell survival
rationale: Members are XBP1 and ATF4 UPR transcription, ER overload and regulation of ER-stress and pancreatic beta-cell apoptosis, unlike confusables on ATF6/CREB3 or integrated stress response translation control.

qualifier: piRNA transposon silencing and sperm chromatin compaction
name: Male germline transposon silencing and sperm chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members span piRNA/DNA-methylation heterochromatin silencing of transposons, sperm DNA condensation, protamine exchange and spermatogonial division, versus confusables on germ cell specification or piRNA biogenesis.

qualifier: nucleolar chromatin regulation of RNA polymerase I
name: Ribosomal RNA gene transcription and nucleolar chromatin regulation
rationale: Members are Pol I initiation, elongation and termination, 5S rRNA transcription and rDNA chromatin regulators (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1, CSB/G9a), unlike confusables on tRNA/snRNA Pol III transcription or rRNA cleavage.

qualifier: elongation complex formation and Tat-mediated pause recovery
name: HIV-1 elongation complex formation and Tat-mediated pause recovery
rationale: All three members are HIV-1 elongation complex assembly with or without Tat and Tat-dependent pause recovery, distinct from host Pol II elongation and from HIV initiation or arrest-focused confusables.
